faqs.q: Do I need an account to use Img Pilot?
faqs.a: No. Core guest tools can be used without creating an account. Guest limits apply, and account features are available when you need saved projects or higher workflow limits.

faqs.q: How long are guest images stored?
faqs.a: Guest images and temporary results expire within one hour. Downloading, refreshing or reprocessing does not extend that deadline.

faqs.q: Will processing overwrite my original image?
faqs.a: No. Processing creates a separate result. The uploaded original remains unchanged during the active guest session.
Core tools support JPG, PNG and WebP. Some conversion workflows may also support AVIF when the server can encode and verify the result.

faqs.q: Can I process several images together?
faqs.a: Yes. Bulk Image Tools support selected compress, resize and convert workflows. Guest batch limits apply.

faqs.q: Does compressing an image always make it smaller?
faqs.a: Not always. The final size depends on the original image, its format and the selected settings. Img Pilot reports the actual result honestly, including when an output is larger.

faqs.q: Is alt text embedded inside the image?
faqs.a: Alt text is normally added to a website or CMS record rather than universally embedded in the image file. The Metadata Editor helps you prepare and export it for use on your website.

faqs.q: Does image optimization guarantee better search rankings?
faqs.a: No. Image optimization can support performance, organization and accessibility, but no individual image tool can guarantee search rankings.
